description: Assign contact models to existing contacts. The selected contact model applies to contacts in the specified range. If no range is specified, then all contacts in the model are affected. This command replaces the contact model entirely - all information stored in the previous contact model is lost. The contact model can be a built-in model or a plug-in model registered with the program load command. By default, mechanical contacts are considered. Built-in models include linear, linearpbond, linearcbond, rrlinear, arrlinear, hertz, hysteretic, smoothjoint, flatjoint, softbond, burger, hill, beam, and null; 7.0 adds jkr, eepa, mohr, bilinear, lineardipole, springnetwork, subspringnetwork, and fish (user-defined), and 9.0 adds rrhertz and bisubspringnetwork.

methods.description: Set contact model on a contact object

notes: Python SDK requires iteration over contacts - cannot assign model to all contacts in one call
Command interface is more efficient for bulk model assignment
Use range specification in command interface to avoid Python iteration

6.0: Live 6.0 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>'); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself. Model names: see the contact-models reference.
7.0: Live 7.0 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>'); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself. Model names: see the contact-models reference.
9.0: Live 9.7 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>' / 'contact fluid <sub>' - fluid is 9.x-new); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself. Model names: see the contact-models reference.

examples.command: contact model null range group 'bottom-platen' match 2
examples.description: Disable contacts in 'bottom-platen' group with match count of 2 (from BBM example) (model: null).
Change all ball-ball contacts to linearpbond model (from CMAT example) (model: linearpbond).

Change contacts in 'soil' group to linear model (model: linear).

examples.command: contact model hertz range contact type 'ball-ball'
